question: Which of the following countries performed its first robotic docking in lunar orbit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The manoeuvre was part of the ambitious** Chang’e-5 mission** named after a mythical Chinese Moon goddess to bring back the first lunar samples in four decades.
 
• **China's first **lunar probe, the** Chang'e-1**, was a robotic spacecraft that orbited the moon in **2007 and hit the surface in 2009.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** China.**

 
 
• Capital: **Beijing**.
 
• Currency: **Chinese Yuan**.
 
• The present Indian embassy in China: **Mr Pradeep kumar Rawat.**
 
 
 
• **Japan**.
 
 
• Capital: **Tokyo.**
 
• Currency:** Japanese yen**.
 
• The present Indian embassy in Japan is **Sanjay Kumar Verma**.
 
 
 
• Russia.​
 
 
• Capital: **Moscow.​**
 
• Currency: **Russian ruble**.
 
• The present Indian embassy in Russia-**Kapoor.**​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Apollo 11**-First moon mission in the world **(July 16, 1969**).
 
• **Chandrayan-1 **is the first moon mission of India,(2008).
 
• **Neil Armstrong and Edwin "Buzz"** Aldrin were the first of 12 human beings to walk on the Moon.
 
• **Rakesh Sharma **was the first Indian astronaut to travel in space.
